# hyperfluid_role_permissions (Resource)

The permission bundle of a role, managed authoritatively: Terraform makes the role hold exactly `permissions`, removing any permission added elsewhere, and destroying the resource empties the bundle. It is the only resource that manages a role's permissions (`hyperfluid_role` leaves them alone): manage each role with a single `hyperfluid_role_permissions`.

System roles are managed by the platform and refuse edits; duplicate one to customize it. Requires `role:read` and `role:update`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hyperfluid_role" "auditor" {
  name = "auditor"
}

# Authoritative: the role holds exactly these permissions, and destroying the
# resource empties its bundle. System roles refuse edits.
resource "hyperfluid_role_permissions" "auditor" {
  role_id = hyperfluid_role.auditor.id
  permissions = [
    "secret:list",
    "grant:read",
    "group:read",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (Set of String) Permission keys the role holds, e.g. `secret:read`. The `hyperfluid_permissions` data source lists them. An empty set leaves the role with no permission.
- `role_id` (String) Id of a custom role (`hyperfluid_role.id`). Changing this moves management to another role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The role id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import id is the role id (uuid).
terraform import hyperfluid_role_permissions.auditor 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
